Description: Fragments of Joshua from Qumran Cave 4, published as 4QJosha (DJD 14). The surviving text spans five chapters (5, 6, 7, 8, 10), including the fall of Jericho material (chapter 6), the Achan episode (chapter 7), and the southern campaign (chapter 10). The Leon Levy record shows 44 images of this manuscript.
Significance: The oldest and fullest Qumran witness to Joshua. Its text shows variations in wording and omissions against the Masoretic Text, with some readings aligning with the Greek text rather than the Masoretic Text; the altar-building sequence question (Gilgal versus Mount Ebal) is discussed in the DJD 14 edition (Ulrich) and by Tov. Wording of that significance claim should be re-checked against DJD 14 before publication, as it rests on secondary summaries.
